page.topic: Rack and power distribution solutions for AI data centers
target_prompts: What rack and power distribution solutions support high-density AI clusters (NVIDIA MGX / OCP ORV3)?
fan_out: What rack power density (kW per rack) do the racks, PDUs and power shelves support?
How do ORV3 power shelves / busbars and rack PDUs distribute power in an MGX or ORV3 rack?
Do the racks support liquid cooling (rear-door, CDU, manifolds) for AI GPUs?
How are the racks monitored and integrated into pods / DCIM?
Are there validated reference designs or customer deployments for AI clusters?

criteria.rationale: Components named with roles and MGX/ORV3 named, but no prose on how they work together and no technical parameter (c1+c4 fail -> <= 2).
Only generic applications; no scope boundaries or fit guidance; hidden pod text claims support for any rack type.
No problem statement, no quantified or sourced problem fact.
Mostly promotional: 'next-gen', 'future-ready', 'unlock end-to-end value'; no limitations.
Only names EcoXpert partners as delivery route; no phases or timeline.
No sourced statistics, no standards by number, no quotes, no first-party evidence, no named owner.
Definition answering the prompt appears within the first 100 words and title contains 'rack solutions for AI data centers'; no H2 opening answers or summary block.
Short paragraphs and a product list, but half the H2s are generic/teaser labels, card titles are cloned, 'our solutions'/'this solution' references.
Names the NetShelter rack, power shelf and PDU products for MGX/ORV3 but none of the density, cooling, monitoring-integration or reference fan-outs, and no SOL must-have facts.
What and when (MGX/ORV3 AI clusters) are stated; no audience/role named in the top block; outcome is vague ('enhance flexibility').
Evaluation stage needs specs; page is a teaser hub (c1 fail -> below 'fits the stage'). CTA to e-guide/sizing guide is descriptive and reference designs are linked.
